text:
Situation: Penicillin G potassium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-04-26 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 11.6 days of injection and 24.3 days of powder. Corvale General holds 15.4 days of injection and 20.6 days of powder.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2023-04-26. The registered plant Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) appears on a product label. FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-09-10. That plant has a history of VAI classifications from inspections ending 2009-02-18 through 2023-06-16. Other manufacturers on FDA's shortage list include Laboratorios Atral and Pfizer Inc., with Pfizer noting a manufacturing delay and estimated recovery in 4Q 2027.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly two to three weeks. The rule-identified best option is Athenex Pharmaceutical Division, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Athenex Pharmaceutical Division, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Avenacy Inc.; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Chartwell RX, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify and place orders with HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Laboratorios Atral, S.A.; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Relying solely on existing manufacturers on FDA's shortage list given Pfizer's estimated recovery in 4Q 2027 and no near-term resolution indicated.
